metadata.source: Synthetic but realistic examples based on public methodology, no private reports
metadata.provenance: Synthetic examples created from public methodology, no private data, no PII, no secrets, normalized, deduped, classified

examples.discovery_methodology: Recon: spider /search, check if q param reflected. Test: /search?q=<script>alert(1)</script> returns payload unescaped in HTML.
examples.evidence_pattern: GET /search?q=<script>alert(1)</script> -> 200, body contains <script>alert(1)</script> unescaped, executes in browser
examples.validation_method: Reproduce with witness payload, check if executes, try bypasses, confirm not inside comment or encoded
examples.impact: Reflected XSS, requires user click, can steal session if HttpOnly not set, low to high depending on context
examples.report_structure: Endpoint: /search, Param: q, Payload: <script>alert(1)</script>, Evidence: response contains payload unescaped, Repro: 1. Go to /search?q=<script>alert(1)</script> 2. Observe alert, Impact: session hijacking, Remediation: encode output

examples.prerequisite: Endpoint uses numeric ID, auth required, but no ownership check
examples.discovery_methodology: Recon: check /api/users/me returns id 123 for user A. Test: as user A, GET /api/users/124 (user B) returns 200 with user B data (minimal proof, redact PII).
examples.evidence_pattern: GET /api/users/124 with user A token -> 200, body contains other user data (redact PII to last 6 chars in chat)
examples.validation_method: Reproduce with two accounts: user A (id 123) and user B (id 124), confirm user A can access user B data, check without auth should be 401, try different IDs
examples.impact: Access to other users' PII, critical if sensitive data
examples.remediation: Authorization check, random UUIDs, deny by default
examples.report_structure: Endpoint: /api/users/{id}, Method: GET, IDs: user A 123, user B 124, Evidence: user A token to /api/users/124 returns 200 with other user data, Repro: 1. Auth as user A 2. GET /api/users/124 3. Observe other user data, Impact: PII exposure, Remediation: check authz

examples.prerequisite: id param goes to SQL without sanitization
examples.discovery_methodology: Recon: /api/users?id=123 returns user. Test: /api/users?id=123' causes SQL error, /api/users?id=123 AND 1=1 returns same, AND 1=2 returns different, SLEEP(2) delays 2 sec.
examples.evidence_pattern: GET /api/users?id=123' -> 500 with SQL error, GET /api/users?id=123 AND SLEEP(2) -> delay 2 sec
examples.validation_method: Reproduce with quote for error, boolean for difference, time for delay (minimal 2 sec), confirm genuine SQL error not generic
examples.impact: Data extraction, auth bypass, RCE depending on DB
examples.report_structure: Endpoint: /api/users, Param: id, Payload: ' AND SLEEP(2) --, Evidence: delay 2 sec, Repro: 1. GET /api/users?id=123 AND SLEEP(2) -- 2. Observe delay, Impact: data extraction, Remediation: parameterized queries

examples.prerequisite: url param fetches remote resource without validation
examples.discovery_methodology: Recon: /api/fetch?url=https://example.com returns example.com content. Test: /api/fetch?url=http://127.0.0.1 returns internal data or 200, http://169.254.169.254 requires approval.
examples.evidence_pattern: GET /api/fetch?url=http://127.0.0.1 -> 200 with internal data or 200, tool output
examples.validation_method: Reproduce with internal URL, check if internal data returned, bypass via 0.0.0.0, etc.
examples.impact: Access to internal services, cloud metadata if approved and vulnerable, RCE
examples.remediation: Validate URLs, allow list, deny private IPs
examples.report_structure: Endpoint: /api/fetch, Param: url, Payload: http://127.0.0.1, Evidence: returns internal data, Repro: 1. GET /api/fetch?url=http://127.0.0.1 2. Observe internal, Impact: internal access, Remediation: validate URLs
